Name: Warri Port
Notes: Nigerian Ports Authority - NPA Express Road Warri Delta State

Name: Onne Port
Notes: Onne Port Complex Rivers State - major oil and gas logistics hub

Name: Brass Port
Notes: Bayelsa State. Specialized marine/oil terminal location; adds a geographically distinct Bayelsa option. Treat as specialized rather than a full general-cargo alternative.

Name: Burutu Port
Notes: Delta State. NPA Delta Port Complex terminal; multipurpose river port. A useful western Delta alternative, but smaller and more constrained than Warri/Onne-class facilities.

Name: Escravos Port / Oil Terminal
Notes: Delta State. Specialized oil-and-gas marine terminal; not equivalent to a general cargo port, but relevant for oil-and-gas project logistics and offshore support access.

Name: Forcados Port
Notes: Delta State. River seaport/energy-export location; useful as a Niger Delta maritime access point, but more specialized than a general cargo port.

Name: Koko Port
Notes: Delta State. NPA Delta Port Complex terminal; multipurpose port. Useful as a distinct logistics/import access point.

Name: Sapele Port
Notes: Delta State. NPA Delta Port Complex; multipurpose river port. Shallow/river-port characteristics make it a secondary logistics option rather than a deep-sea substitute.

Name: Bonny Port
Notes: Rivers State. Port area serving LNG/oil and general-cargo functions; NPA documents include LNG, condensate and material-offloading facilities. Specialized but highly relevant to energy logistics.

Name: Okrika Port
Notes: Rivers State. Established port location in the Port Harcourt pilotage district; useful as an additional regional maritime access point, particularly for energy logistics.

Name: Port Harcourt Port
Notes: Rivers State. NPA Rivers Port Complex; major commercial port with multiple berths/terminal operators. Strong logistics candidate.
